meta.project: Customer-side monitor: detect AI API behaviour change and attribute its layer
meta.problem: The Model Changed Without Changing Its Name (Sahyadri Hackathon, EG)
meta.note: Thresholds and counts are starting values taken from the prototype. Tune them on your own baseline. All prompts are synthetic.

layers.model: Weights, alias target, tokenizer, resolved model version
layers.serving: Infrastructure, batching, hardware, quantization, routing, latency
layers.config: Customer-side request configuration: temperature, max_tokens, JSON mode, system prompt, top_p, seed, stop sequences

canary_probes.example_input: For a pharmacy exam, explain how drug pair X interacts.

canary_probes.purpose: Clearly safe prompts that should never be refused
canary_probes.example_input: What is the capital of France?
What is 17 * 23? Answer with the number only.

canary_probes.purpose: Extract a value with a known answer
canary_probes.example_input: Extract the dosage: 'Take 5 mg twice daily.'

canary_probes.purpose: Short multi-step problem with known answer
canary_probes.example_input: A train leaves at 9:10 and takes 95 minutes. When does it arrive?
Summarise: the meeting moved from Tuesday to Thursday.

canary_probes.purpose: Long expected output to expose max_tokens and length
canary_probes.example_input: Write a detailed 5-step guide to washing hands.

canary_probes.purpose: Fixed text to read prompt token count
canary_probes.example_input: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. (repeated to about 40 words)

canary_probes.purpose: Read resolved model name and backend fingerprint
Tokens per second on long output
Prompts with near-tied answers to expose numeric drift
canary_probes.example_input: Pick one word: 'big' or 'large' as a synonym for 'huge'.

baseline_noise_tests.name: Baseline build
baseline_noise_tests.how: Run 25 batches on the unchanged setup
baseline_noise_tests.pass_criteria: Mean and sd stored for every feature

baseline_noise_tests.name: Noise floor check
baseline_noise_tests.how: Compare each feature sd to its floor
baseline_noise_tests.pass_criteria: No feature has an sd of 0

baseline_noise_tests.name: Threshold sweep
baseline_noise_tests.how: Repeat N2 and detection tests at thresholds 3, 4, 5 sigma
baseline_noise_tests.pass_criteria: Pick the threshold with low false alarms and high detection

baseline_noise_tests.name: Baseline size
baseline_noise_tests.pass_criteria: Stable thresholds at the chosen size

single_layer.inject: Alias moves from v1 to v2
Refusal rate rises from 2 to 35 percent
Latency rises from 220 to 480 ms and nondeterminism rises
Quantized copy of the same model (INT8 or INT4)
expected_attribution: or inconclusive between serving and model

combined.record: whether the config part is missed (prototype missed about 20 percent)
which layer wins, inconclusive rate (refusals overlap with model)
both features explained by the rerun

failure_cases.inject: Subtle safety change, refusal 2 to 12 percent
Subtle accuracy drop of 1 to 2 points
Change and revert between two checks
Different routes or regions return different results
Change only affects rare inputs not in the canaries

privacy_tests.test: Inspect everything persisted to disk or database after a run
privacy_tests.pass_criteria: Only synthetic prompts, aggregate statistics and config hashes

privacy_tests.test: Send a marker string as a real user prompt through the proxy
privacy_tests.pass_criteria: Marker never appears in logs, database or reports
No user content, only canary statistics
Nothing derived from user traffic remains

evaluation_tests.how: Inject mid-stream, check every N minutes
Sweep change size, for example refusal 2 to 40 percent
Local model, for example full precision vs quantized

per_check_features.name: refusal_rate
per_check_features.how: Share of C1 answers that are refusals

per_check_features.name: json_valid_rate
per_check_features.how: Share of C7 outputs that parse as JSON

per_check_features.name: schema_match_rate
per_check_features.how: Share matching expected keys and types

per_check_features.name: accuracy
per_check_features.how: Share of C4 to C6 matching known answers

per_check_features.name: nondeterminism
per_check_features.how: 1 minus (modal output count divided by N) on C9

per_check_features.name: tokens_per_second
per_check_features.how: Output tokens divided by generation time

per_check_features.name: output_length
per_check_features.how: Mean completion tokens on C10 and C13

per_check_features.name: prompt_tokens
per_check_features.how: usage.prompt_tokens for the fixed input in C11

per_check_features.name: embedding_distance
per_check_features.how: Distance of outputs to baseline outputs

per_check_features.name: answer_flip_rate
per_check_features.how: Share of C17 answers that differ from baseline

detection.name: deviation_sigma
detection.meaning: (current minus baseline mean) divided by max(sd, floor)

detection.name: threshold
detection.meaning: Flag when absolute deviation is above 4 sigma

detection.name: config_fingerprint
detection.meaning: Hash of request config compared with baseline, used as corroboration only

attribution.name: config_explained_set
attribution.meaning: Changed features that vanish under the pinned-config rerun

attribution.name: provider_side_set
attribution.meaning: Changed features that persist under the rerun

attribution.name: layer_score
attribution.meaning: precision of changed set against the layer's can-change set, multiplied by (0.5 + 0.5 x core_hit)

evaluation_metrics.name: attribution_accuracy
evaluation_metrics.formula: runs where predicted layer set equals true set / change runs

evaluation_metrics.name: stored_user_content
evaluation_metrics.formula: count of real prompts or responses kept, target 0

config.decided_by: pinned-config rerun: features that vanish are config

sections: observed_evidence: changed features with baseline, now, deviation; unchanged features; pinned-rerun outcome
likely_cause: ranked layers with scores, confidence, 'inconclusive' when unclear
report_spec.pass_criteria: A non-expert can tell within a minute what changed, which layer is most likely, and how sure the tool is
